task_description:
# AFL Formation Templates

Pre-built starting formation templates for common AFL setups (e.g., standard setup, zone defense, press, spread). One click positions all players in a recognized formation.

## Rationale
Saves time on initial setup and provides starting points for tactical variations. This is an AFL-specific feature that multi-sport tools can't offer, strengthening differentiation.

## User Stories
- As a coach, I want to quickly set up standard formations without dragging 36 players
- As a coaching educator, I want to demonstrate common AFL formations easily

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] At least 5 pre-built formation templates
- [ ] Template selector in toolbar or sidebar
- [ ] Applying template positions all 36 players
- [ ] Can modify formation after applying template
- [ ] Templates include both team formations
- [ ] Users can save custom templates

player_management.description: Players are managed in Zustand playerStore with 36 players (18 per team: team1, team2)
player_management.missing: Batch update method for updating all 36 players simultaneously

player_model.description: Player interface with id, teamId, position [x,y,z], rotation, color, number
player_model.structure: position is 3D array [x, y, z], teamId is 'team1' | 'team2'

dexie_pattern.description: IndexedDB persistence using Dexie with class-based database and Table interface
dexie_pattern.pattern: class PlaybookDatabase extends Dexie { playbooks!: Table<Playbook>; constructor() { super('AFLPlaybookDB'); this.version(1).stores({ playbooks: '++id, name, createdAt' }); } }
dexie_pattern.usage: Auto-incrementing IDs with ++id, indexed fields for querying

zustand_store.description: Functional Zustand stores with actions using create() function
zustand_store.pattern: export const usePlayerStore = create<PlayerState>((set, get) => ({ /* state and actions */ }))
zustand_store.immutability: State updates use immutable patterns with map/spread operators

toolbar_ui.description: Toolbar component with Tailwind buttons and modal dialogs
toolbar_ui.button_pattern: className='px-4 py-2 bg-[color]-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-[color]-600 transition'
toolbar_ui.dialog_pattern: Conditional rendering with showDialog state, backdrop-blur-sm, rounded-lg shadow-xl

playbook_save.description: Existing playbook save/load pattern for capturing player positions
playbook_save.pattern: saveCurrentScenario captures players, camera, annotations and saves to Dexie
playbook_save.relevance: Similar pattern needed for custom formation saving

playbookStore.ts - pattern to follow for formationStore
